channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Intraarterial dexamethasone may reduce pain after uterine fibroid embolization
item.description: Intraarterial dexamethasone provided greater pain relief after uterine fibroid embolization than placebo, according to a study.

item.title: Simpler estrogen cream application may prevent repeat UTIs
item.description: For postmenopausal women, applying estrogen cream around the urinary opening may be as effective as vaginal insertion for preventing recurrent UTIs.

item.title: Nurses face workplace assaults with little support [PODCAST]
item.description: A nurse recounts surviving a violent assault at work and the lack of response from her hospital, in this podcast episode.

item.title: Housing assistance tied to improved NSCLC survival
item.description: Older adults with NSCLC who received housing assistance had lower mortality, though the survival benefit was not linked to differences in genomic factors.
